definitions: A complicated or clandestine plot or scheme intended to effect some purpose by secret artifice; conspiracy; stratagem; the practice of engaging in hidden schemes.
Clandestine intercourse between persons; illicit intimacy; a liaison or affair.
To conceive or carry out a secret plan intended to harm; to form a plot or scheme.
To arouse the interest of; to fascinate.

blocks.text: Intrigue or The Martyrium is a 1920 German silent drama film directed by Paul L. Stein and starring Pola Negri and Eduard von Winterstein.
Intrigue (Spanish:Intriga) is a 1942 Spanish comedy mystery film directed by Antonio Román and starring Blanca de Silos and Manolo Morán. It is based on a novel by Wenceslao Fernández Flórez.

Intrigue is a 1947 American film noir crime film directed by Edwin L. Marin and starring George Raft, June Havoc and Helena Carter. Intrigue was intended to be the first of a number of films Raft made, with producer Sam Bischoff, for his own production company, Star Films. It was one of several movies Raft made with Marin.
